source: Descriptive historical 5m regimes classified using already completed bars

settings.method: Fixed heuristic classifications; no fitted parameters or strategy changes

warnings: Market regimes are descriptive, retrospective, and not individually predictive or traded.
Period and regime comparisons reuse the same 14-day sample; do not select a winning filter based on these results and call it validated.
Stop exits cannot alone establish false-breakout causes.
